loadErrorTitle: Configuration data could not be fully loaded

noAccess.title: You don't have access to Server Configuration
noAccess.description: This page requires the "Manage server files" permission. Ask an administrator to grant it to your role if you need to edit server settings here.

duplicateKeysWarning.title_one: "{{keys}}" appears more than once in this configuration file
duplicateKeysWarning.title_other: {{count}} settings appear more than once in this configuration file: {{keys}}
duplicateKeysWarning.desc: This editor reads the last copy and the Mods page reads the first, so the two can show different values for the same setting.

serverChangedBanner.title: Active server changed
serverChangedBanner.desc: The active server changed while this page was open. The settings below are still from the previous server -- reload before saving, or the save would overwrite the new active server's config.

pageHeader.title: Server Configuration
pageHeader.description: Edit the live INI, sandbox, spawn, and mod settings for this server.

unresolvedReview.title: Unresolved Mods= IDs
unresolvedReview.causeUnknown: No triage available for this entry yet — re-run diagnostics.
unresolvedReview.causeTypo: Looks like a typo of the installed mod "{{suggestion}}".
unresolvedReview.causeStillDownloading: A Workshop download is in progress — wait for it to finish, then re-run diagnostics.
unresolvedReview.causeWorkshopNotOnDisk: Listed in WorkshopItems= but its content isn't on disk and nothing is downloading it right now. Restart the server or re-validate the Workshop download, then re-run diagnostics.
unresolvedReview.causeAbsent: No installed Workshop or local mod matches this ID.
unresolvedReview.correctedToast: Replaced "{{modId}}" with "{{suggestion}}" in Mods=. Unsaved — review and save below.
unresolvedReview.removeConfirm: Remove "{{modId}}" from Mods=? This only stages the change here — nothing is written to disk until you save.
unresolvedReview.removedToast: Removed "{{modId}}" from Mods=. Unsaved — review and save below.

stopServerAlert.title: The server is running
stopServerAlert.description: You can save changes now. Depending on what you're editing, they may need a server restart to take effect — the confirmation after saving will tell you.
stopServerAlert.unknownTitle: Can't confirm the server is stopped
stopServerAlert.unknownDescription: We couldn't determine whether the server is currently running. If it is, changes may need a server restart to take effect — the confirmation after saving will tell you.

invalidValuesAlert.title: Fix invalid values before saving
invalidValuesAlert.description: {{settings}} must be valid numbers within the shown range.

categoriesNav.uncategorizedIniTitle: Keys present in your INI file but not in the schema (newer vanilla keys, mod-injected keys, or custom)
categoriesNav.uncategorizedSandboxTitle: Sandbox settings not yet grouped by the editor

uncategorizedIni.heading: Uncategorized / Unknown Keys
uncategorizedIni.description: Keys present in your INI but not recognized by the schema. Likely newer vanilla settings or mod-injected. Values are preserved on save — edit with care.

uncategorizedSandbox.heading: Additional Sandbox Settings
uncategorizedSandbox.description: Settings the editor has no schema for, grouped by the section that owns them. Mostly mod-added keys. Edit with care.

categoryContent.noneModified: No settings in this category differ from Project Zomboid defaults.
categoryContent.noneUnsaved: No unsaved settings in this category.

iniTab.luaChecksumBody: PanelBridge modifies server-side Lua files. With Lua Checksum enabled, clients will fail verification and cannot connect. Disable <1>DoLuaChecksum</1> in the Mods category to allow players to join.

sandboxTab.build42Body: Sandbox values and option wording in this editor are aligned to Project Zomboid Build 42 defaults.

spawnPointsTab.modManagedBody: Spawn locations are typically handled by mods like “Spawn Select.” Switch to <1>raw</1> to inspect or edit the file directly.

spawnRegionsTab.noRegionsDesc: Try switching to Raw mode to view the file contents
spawnRegionsTab.mapFilePathTip: Must exactly match a map file that already exists in this server's Maps folder — no extension, and it's case-sensitive. Get it wrong and the game either skips this region or fails to start.

modSettingsTab.modifiedFilterTitle: Show only options changed from default
modSettingsTab.notLoadedDescPrefix: Click load to fetch sandbox options from all installed mods via PanelBridge
modSettingsTab.notLoadedDescSuffix: . The PZ server must be running with PanelBridge active.
modSettingsTab.panelBridgeTip: PanelBridge is the Lua mod that runs on the game server and gives this panel live access to sandbox options, weather, teleport, and item control. Mod settings only load once it's installed on the server and the server is running.
modSettingsTab.loadFailedNotConnected: Failed to load mod settings. Is PanelBridge connected?
modSettingsTab.loadFailedCheckConnection: Failed to load mod settings. Check PanelBridge connection.
modSettingsTab.noOptionsDesc: The server returned no sandbox options. This may happen if no mods register custom sandbox settings, or the API isn't available in this PZ build.
modSettingsTab.modifiedBadgeTitle: Options that differ from their default value
modSettingsTab.noModifiedOptions: No options have been modified from their defaults.

stickySaveBar.hint: ctrl+s to save · applies on reload

backupsDialog.title: Configuration Backups
backupsDialog.description: Restore a previous version of your configuration files. Backups are created automatically when you save.
backupsDialog.emptyDesc: Backups are created automatically when you save any config file
backupsDialog.restoreTooltip: Replace current file with this backup

templatesDialog.title: Saved Configs
templatesDialog.applyTip: Applying a saved config replaces ALL of your current settings — it doesn't merge with what's there now. The panel backs up what's live before applying, so Restore can undo it, but the server must be stopped first.
templatesDialog.description: Save your current configuration, or load one you saved earlier.
templatesDialog.emptyDesc: Click 'Save Current Config' to create your first one

saveTemplateDialog.title: Save Current Config
saveTemplateDialog.description: Save your current INI and/or Sandbox settings so you can load them again later.

deleteTemplateConfirm.title: Delete saved config?
deleteTemplateConfirm.description: Delete saved config "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.

applyTemplateConfirm.title: Apply saved config "{{name}}"?
applyTemplateConfirm.description: Replace your current server settings with this saved config? The panel backs up what's live first, so Restore can undo it if needed.
applyTemplateConfirm.rconWarning: The RCON password isn't stored in saved configs, so applying this one will remove your server's RCON password — you'll need to re-enter it afterward.

restoreBackupConfirm.title: Restore this backup?
restoreBackupConfirm.description: Replace the current file with "{{filename}}"? Unsaved changes to the live config will be lost.

fileBrowserDialog.title: Select Image File
fileBrowserDialog.description: Browse to find a PNG image file for your server.
fileBrowserDialog.emptyNoParent: No image files found in this directory
fileBrowserDialog.emptyWithParent: No image files here — try a different folder

toasts.serverChangedSinceLoad: The active server changed since this page loaded. Reload before saving to avoid overwriting the wrong server.
toasts.savedRestartToApply: Settings saved. Restart server to apply changes.
toasts.copyFailed: Failed to copy content to clipboard.
toasts.bridgeUnverifiedDesc: {{action}} was sent, but the mod could not confirm it took effect.
toasts.bridgeOldBridgeDesc: {{action}} may have worked, but this PanelBridge mod version doesn't report back whether it did. Update the mod to confirm results.
toasts.worldSaveFailedDesc: {{option}} was applied, but the server's world save failed ({{reason}}), so it may not survive the next restart.
toasts.notPersistedDesc: {{option}} is not in SandboxVars.lua, so it will reset when the server restarts.
toasts.willResetFallback: {{option}} will reset when the server restarts.
toasts.someSandboxKeysNotSavedDesc: The rest was saved, but these could not be written and will reset when the server restarts: {{keys}}
toasts.applyTemplatePartialDesc: {{applied}} settings were written to disk before this failed: {{error}} The rest of the saved config was not applied.

PublicName.label: Server Name
PublicName.description: Your server name as shown to the public.

PublicDescription.label: Server Description
PublicDescription.description: The description that people can see while browsing your server.

Public.label: Public Server
Public.description: Can your server be seen on Steam server browser.

Open.label: Open (No Whitelist)
Open.description: Open to all players without requiring whitelist.

Password.label: Server Password
Password.description: Password required to join the server. Leave empty for no password.

PauseEmpty.label: Pause When Empty
PauseEmpty.description: The server will pause when no players are logged in.

ServerWelcomeMessage.label: Welcome Message
ServerWelcomeMessage.description: The welcome message displayed to players after connecting. Use <LINE> for new lines.

Map.label: Map
Map.description: The map you're playing on. Default is Muldraugh, KY.

SaveWorldEveryMinutes.label: Auto-Save Interval
SaveWorldEveryMinutes.description: Auto-save world every X minutes. 0 = never.

AnnounceDeath.label: Announce Deaths
AnnounceDeath.description: Server-wide announcement when a character dies.

AnnounceAnimalDeath.label: Announce Animal Deaths
AnnounceAnimalDeath.description: Display a global chat message when an animal dies.

Seed.label: World Seed
Seed.description: The worldgen seed used to generate the world. Changing this requires deleting map_worldgen.bin.

DefaultPort.label: Game Port
DefaultPort.description: The port players will use to connect to your server. Must be open on your router.

UPnP.label: Enable UPnP
UPnP.description: Enable UPnP for automatic port forwarding.

PingFrequency.label: Ping Frequency
PingFrequency.description: How often the server checks connection to players (seconds).

PingLimit.label: Ping Limit
PingLimit.description: Ping limit before being kicked (milliseconds). 100 to disable.

DenyLoginOnOverloadedServer.label: Deny Login When Overloaded
DenyLoginOnOverloadedServer.description: Prevent new connections when server is overloaded.

UseTCPForMapDownloads.label: Use TCP for Map Downloads
UseTCPForMapDownloads.description: Use TCP instead of UDP for map downloads.

MaxPacketsPerSecond.label: Max Packets Per Second
MaxPacketsPerSecond.description: Cap on packets per second sent to a connected client. Higher values increase bandwidth use; lower values may cause stutter under load.

UDPPort.label: UDP Port
UDPPort.description: Second port used for UDP connections.

LoginQueueEnabled.label: Login Queue
LoginQueueEnabled.description: Enable a login queue when the server is full.

LoginQueueConnectTimeout.label: Login Queue Timeout
LoginQueueConnectTimeout.description: Seconds before a queued connection times out.

server_browser_announced_ip.label: Announced IP
server_browser_announced_ip.description: IP address broadcast to the server browser. For multi-IP setups like server farms.

MultiplayerStatisticsPeriod.label: Statistics Period
MultiplayerStatisticsPeriod.description: Multiplayer statistics update period in seconds. 0 = disabled.

PVP.label: Enable PvP
PVP.description: Allow player vs player combat (each player can still toggle their own PvP).

SafetySystem.label: Safety System
SafetySystem.description: If PvP is enabled, allows players to toggle their own PvP on/off.

ShowSafety.label: Show Safety Status
ShowSafety.description: Show skull icon for players with safety off.

SafetyToggleTimer.label: Safety Toggle Timer
SafetyToggleTimer.description: Time in seconds to switch between PvP on and off.

SafetyCooldownTimer.label: Safety Cooldown Timer
SafetyCooldownTimer.description: Time in seconds before you can toggle safety again.

PVPMeleeWhileHitReaction.label: Melee While Hit Reaction
PVPMeleeWhileHitReaction.description: Allow melee attacks during hit reaction in PvP.

PlayerBumpPlayer.label: Player Collision
PlayerBumpPlayer.description: Players can bump into each other.

PVPLogToolChat.label: Log PvP to Chat
PVPLogToolChat.description: PvP events are logged to admin chat.

PVPLogToolFile.label: Log PvP to File
PVPLogToolFile.description: PvP events are logged to a file.

SafetyDisconnectDelay.label: Safety Disconnect Delay
SafetyDisconnectDelay.description: Seconds before PvP safety mode resets on disconnect.

ChatStreams.label: Chat Streams
ChatStreams.description: Enabled chat streams: s=say, r=radio, a=admin, w=whisper, y=yell, sh=safehouse, f=faction, all=global.

DisplayUserName.label: Display Usernames
DisplayUserName.description: Show player usernames above their heads and in chat.

ShowFirstAndLastName.label: Show Character Names
ShowFirstAndLastName.description: Display character first and last name instead of username.

MouseOverToSeeDisplayName.label: Mouse Over for Name
MouseOverToSeeDisplayName.description: Require mouse hover to see player names.

HidePlayersBehindYou.label: Hide Players Behind You
HidePlayersBehindYou.description: Hide player names for players behind your character.

BanKickGlobalSound.label: Ban/Kick Sound
BanKickGlobalSound.description: Play global sound when a player is banned or kicked.

UsernameDisguises.label: Username Disguises
UsernameDisguises.description: Allow players to disguise their username.

HideDisguisedUserName.label: Hide Disguised Names
HideDisguisedUserName.description: Hide the real username of disguised players.

ChatMessageSlowModeTime.label: Chat Slow Mode
ChatMessageSlowModeTime.description: Seconds between allowed chat messages per player.

MaxAccountsPerUser.label: Max Accounts Per User
MaxAccountsPerUser.description: Limit accounts per Steam user. 0 = unlimited.

DropOffWhiteListAfterDeath.label: Remove From Whitelist On Death
DropOffWhiteListAfterDeath.description: Remove player from whitelist if their character dies.

KickFastPlayers.label: Kick Speed Hackers
KickFastPlayers.description: Kick players moving faster than possible. May be buggy.

SpawnPoint.label: Spawn Point
SpawnPoint.description: Custom spawn point coordinates (X,Y,Z). 0,0,0 for default.

SpawnItems.label: Spawn Items
SpawnItems.description: Items new characters spawn with (comma-separated, e.g., Base.BaseballBat,Base.WaterBottleFull).

SleepNeeded.label: Sleep Required
SleepNeeded.description: Whether players need to sleep when exhausted.

PlayerRespawnWithOther.label: Respawn with Partner
PlayerRespawnWithOther.description: Enable spawning at splitscreen partner location.

PlayerSaveOnDamage.label: Save on Damage
PlayerSaveOnDamage.description: Save player state when they take damage.

Faction.label: Enable Factions
Faction.description: Allow creation and use of factions.

FactionDaySurvivedToCreate.label: Days to Create Faction
FactionDaySurvivedToCreate.description: Days a player must survive to create a faction.

FactionPlayersRequiredForTag.label: Players for Faction Tag
FactionPlayersRequiredForTag.description: Players required in faction to show tag.

AllowTradeUI.label: Allow Trading
AllowTradeUI.description: Allow players to directly trade with one another.

KnockedDownAllowed.label: Knocked Down
KnockedDownAllowed.description: Allow players to be knocked down. WIP: may cause visual desync.

SneakModeHideFromOtherPlayers.label: Sneak Hides From Players
SneakModeHideFromOtherPlayers.description: Players in sneak mode are hidden from other players.

MapRemotePlayerVisibility.label: Map Player Visibility
MapRemotePlayerVisibility.description: Who can see other players on the in-game map.

HideAdminsInPlayerList.label: Hide Admins in Player List
HideAdminsInPlayerList.description: Hide admin accounts from the player list.

SafehouseAllowTrepass.label: Allow Trespass
SafehouseAllowTrepass.description: Allow non-members to enter safehouses without invite.

SafehouseAllowLoot.label: Allow Looting
SafehouseAllowLoot.description: Allow non-members to take items from safehouses.

SafehouseAllowRespawn.label: Allow Safehouse Respawn
SafehouseAllowRespawn.description: Players can respawn in their safehouse.

SafehouseDaySurvivedToClaim.label: Days to Claim Safehouse
SafehouseDaySurvivedToClaim.description: Days a player must survive before claiming a safehouse.

SafeHouseRemovalTime.label: Safehouse Removal Time
SafeHouseRemovalTime.description: Real-time hours of inactivity before removal from safehouse.

DisableSafehouseWhenOwnerConnected.label: Disable When Owner Online
DisableSafehouseWhenOwnerConnected.description: Disable safehouse protection when the owner is connected. (Renamed from DisableSafehouseWhenPlayerConnected in the Dec 2025 MP patch.)

SafehouseAllowNonResidential.label: Allow Non-Residential
SafehouseAllowNonResidential.description: Allow players to claim non-residential buildings as safehouses.

TrashDeleteAll.label: Delete All Trash
TrashDeleteAll.description: Delete all items when placed in trash.

RemovePlayerCorpsesOnCorpseRemoval.label: Remove Player Corpses
RemovePlayerCorpsesOnCorpseRemoval.description: Remove player corpses when corpse removal runs.

AllowDestructionBySledgehammer.label: Sledgehammer Destruction
AllowDestructionBySledgehammer.description: Allow players to destroy world objects with sledgehammer.

SafehousePreventsLootRespawn.label: Safehouse Blocks Loot Respawn
SafehousePreventsLootRespawn.description: Items will not respawn in buildings claimed as safehouses.

SledgehammerOnlyInSafehouse.label: Sledgehammer Only in Safehouse
SledgehammerOnlyInSafehouse.description: Restrict sledgehammer destruction to safehouses only. Requires Sledgehammer Destruction enabled.

WorkshopItems.label: Workshop Items
WorkshopItems.description: Steam Workshop item IDs to download (semicolon-separated).

DoLuaChecksum.label: Lua Checksum
DoLuaChecksum.description: Verify client Lua matches server. Must be disabled when using PanelBridge — the mod modifies server-side Lua files, which causes checksum mismatches and prevents players from connecting.

SteamScoreboard.label: Steam Scoreboard
SteamScoreboard.description: Show Steam usernames and avatars. true/false/admin.

SteamVAC.label: VAC Ban Check
SteamVAC.description: Check if connecting players have VAC bans.

DiscordChatChannel.label: Discord Chat Channel
DiscordChatChannel.description: The Discord channel name for game chat.

DiscordLogChannel.label: Discord Log Channel
DiscordLogChannel.description: The Discord channel name for server logs.

DiscordCommandChannel.label: Discord Command Channel
DiscordCommandChannel.description: The Discord channel name for commands.

WebhookAddress.label: Webhook URL
WebhookAddress.description: Slack/Discord incoming webhook URL for notifications.

ResetID.label: Reset ID
ResetID.description: Removing this resets zombies and loot (not time).

ServerPlayerID.label: Server Player ID
ServerPlayerID.description: Identifies if character is from another server.

CarEngineAttractionModifier.label: Car Engine Attraction
CarEngineAttractionModifier.description: Modifier for zombie attraction to car engines.

ZombieUpdateMaxHighPriority.label: Zombie High Priority Updates
ZombieUpdateMaxHighPriority.description: Max high priority zombie updates per tick.

SwitchZombiesOwnershipEachUpdate.label: Switch Zombie Ownership
SwitchZombiesOwnershipEachUpdate.description: Switch zombie ownership between players each update tick.

UltraSpeedDoesnotAffectToAnimals.label: Ultra Speed Ignores Animals
UltraSpeedDoesnotAffectToAnimals.description: Ultra speed mode does not affect animal simulation.

War.label: Enable Faction War
War.description: Enable faction war system. (Disabled by default since the Dec 2025 MP patch.)

WarStartDelay.label: War Start Delay
WarStartDelay.description: Seconds before war starts after being declared.

WarSafehouseHitPoints.label: War Safehouse Hit Points
WarSafehouseHitPoints.description: Safehouse hit points during faction war.

DisableRadioStaff.label: Disable Radio for Staff
DisableRadioStaff.description: Disable radio transmissions from staff access level.

DisableRadioAdmin.label: Disable Radio for Admins
DisableRadioAdmin.description: Disable radio transmissions from admin access level.

DisableRadioGM.label: Disable Radio for GMs
DisableRadioGM.description: Disable radio transmissions from GM access level.

DisableRadioOverseer.label: Disable Radio for Overseers
DisableRadioOverseer.description: Disable radio transmissions from overseer access level.

DisableRadioModerator.label: Disable Radio for Moderators
DisableRadioModerator.description: Disable radio transmissions from moderator access level.

DisableRadioInvisible.label: Disable Radio for Invisible
DisableRadioInvisible.description: Disable radio transmissions from invisible players.

BackupsCount.label: Backup Count
BackupsCount.description: Number of backup copies to keep.

BackupsOnStart.label: Backup on Start
BackupsOnStart.description: Create a backup when the server starts.

BackupsOnVersionChange.label: Backup on Version Change
BackupsOnVersionChange.description: Create a backup when the game version changes.

BadWordListFile.label: Bad Word List File
BadWordListFile.description: Path to file with prohibited words, one per line.

GoodWordListFile.label: Good Word List File
GoodWordListFile.description: Path to file with allowed words that may contain bad words, one per line.

BadWordPolicy.label: Bad Word Policy
BadWordPolicy.description: Action taken when a bad word is detected in chat.

BadWordReplacement.label: Bad Word Replacement
BadWordReplacement.description: Text that replaces bad words in chat.

AntiCheatSafety.label: Safety
AntiCheatSafety.description: Anti-cheat protection for the safety system.

AntiCheatNoClip.label: No Clip
AntiCheatNoClip.description: Anti-cheat protection against moving through solid objects.

AntiCheatPacketException.label: Packet Exceptions
AntiCheatPacketException.description: Anti-cheat protection for invalid network packets.

ClientCommandFilter.label: Command Log Filter
ClientCommandFilter.description: Semicolon-separated list of commands to exclude from cmd.txt log. Use -vehicle.* to exclude all vehicle, +vehicle.installPart to include specific.

ClientActionLogs.label: Client Action Logs
ClientActionLogs.description: Semicolon-separated list of actions written to ClientActionLogs.txt.

PerkLogs.label: Perk Level Logging
PerkLogs.description: Track changes in player perk levels in PerkLog.txt.

StartYear.label: Start Year
StartYear.description: Which year the game starts in.

StartMonth.label: Start Month
StartMonth.description: Which month the game starts in (1=Jan, 12=Dec).

StartDay.label: Start Day
StartDay.description: Which day of the month the game starts on.

StartTime.label: Start Time
StartTime.description: What time of day the game starts.

Zombies.label: Zombie Count
Zombies.description: Initial zombie population level. Also sets Population Multiplier in Advanced Zombie Options.

Distribution.label: Distribution
Distribution.description: How zombies are distributed across the map.

ZombieRespawn.label: Zombie Respawn
ZombieRespawn.description: How frequently new zombies are added to the world.

ZombieMigrate.label: Zombie Migration
ZombieMigrate.description: Zombies can migrate to empty cells.

LootItemRemovalList.label: Loot Item Removal List
LootItemRemovalList.description: Comma-separated item types removed from the world by the loot cleanup system.

FoodLootNew.label: Food Loot
FoodLootNew.description: Any food that can rot or spoil.

LiteratureLootNew.label: Literature Loot
LiteratureLootNew.description: All readable items including books, fliers, and newspapers.

SkillBookLoot.label: Skill Book Loot
SkillBookLoot.description: Books that provide skill XP multipliers.

MedicalLootNew.label: Medical Loot
MedicalLootNew.description: Medicine, bandages, and first aid tools.

WeaponLootNew.label: Melee Weapon Loot
WeaponLootNew.description: Weapons that are not tools in other categories.

ClothingLootNew.label: Clothing Loot
ClothingLootNew.description: All wearable items that are not containers.

KeyLootNew.label: Key Loot
KeyLootNew.description: Keys for buildings/cars, key rings, and locks.

MementoLootNew.label: Memento Loot
MementoLootNew.description: Spiffo items, plushies, and collectible keepsakes.

CookwareLootNew.label: Cookware Loot
CookwareLootNew.description: Cooking items including those that can be weapons. Does not include food.

FarmingLootNew.label: Farming Loot
FarmingLootNew.description: Seeds, trowels, shovels, and agriculture tools.

ToolLootNew.label: Tool Loot
ToolLootNew.description: Tools not in other categories like Mechanics or Farming.

OtherLootNew.label: Other Loot
OtherLootNew.description: Everything else. Also affects foraging in Town/Road zones.

RollsMultiplier.label: Rolls Multiplier
RollsMultiplier.description: Multiplier for loot table rolls. Higher values may affect performance. NOT recommended to change.

RemoveStoryLoot.label: Remove Story Loot
RemoveStoryLoot.description: Items on the removal list will not spawn in world stories.

RemoveZombieLoot.label: Remove Zombie Loot
RemoveZombieLoot.description: Items on the removal list will not spawn on zombies.

ZombiePopLootEffect.label: Zombie Pop Loot Effect
ZombiePopLootEffect.description: If > 0, loot increases relative to nearby zombies, multiplied by this value.

HoursForLootRespawn.label: Loot Respawn Hours
HoursForLootRespawn.description: Hours after which containers respawn loot. 0 = never.

MaxItemsForLootRespawn.label: Max Items for Respawn
MaxItemsForLootRespawn.description: Containers with this many items or more will not respawn loot.

ConstructionPreventsLootRespawn.label: Construction Blocks Respawn
ConstructionPreventsLootRespawn.description: Player constructions near containers prevent loot respawn.

SeenHoursPreventLootRespawn.label: Seen Hours Prevent Respawn
SeenHoursPreventLootRespawn.description: Hours a zone must be unvisited before loot respawns. 0 = disabled.

InsaneLootFactor.label: Insane Rarity Factor
InsaneLootFactor.description: Spawn rate for Insane rarity items.

ExtremeLootFactor.label: Extreme Rarity Factor
ExtremeLootFactor.description: Spawn rate for Extreme rarity items.

RareLootFactor.label: Rare Rarity Factor
RareLootFactor.description: Spawn rate for Rare rarity items.

NormalLootFactor.label: Normal Rarity Factor
NormalLootFactor.description: Spawn rate for Normal rarity items.

CommonLootFactor.label: Common Rarity Factor
CommonLootFactor.description: Spawn rate for Common rarity items.

AbundantLootFactor.label: Abundant Rarity Factor
AbundantLootFactor.description: Spawn rate for Abundant rarity items.

MaximumLooted.label: Max Looted Building Chance
MaximumLooted.description: Chance that any building is already looted when found.

DaysUntilMaximumLooted.label: Days Until Max Looted
DaysUntilMaximumLooted.description: Days before Maximum Looted Building Chance is reached.

RuralLooted.label: Rural Looted Chance
RuralLooted.description: Chance that any rural building is already looted.

MaximumDiminishedLoot.label: Max Diminished Loot %
MaximumDiminishedLoot.description: Maximum loot that won't spawn when diminished days reached.

DaysUntilMaximumDiminishedLoot.label: Days Until Max Diminished
DaysUntilMaximumDiminishedLoot.description: Days before Maximum Diminished Loot is reached.

MaximumLootedBuildingRooms.label: Max Looted Building Rooms
MaximumLootedBuildingRooms.description: Buildings with more than this many rooms will not be auto-looted.

DayNightCycle.label: Day/Night Cycle
DayNightCycle.description: Whether time of day changes naturally.

ClimateCycle.label: Weather Cycle
ClimateCycle.description: Whether weather changes or remains fixed.

WaterShut.label: Water Shutoff
WaterShut.description: When plumbing fixtures stop being infinite water sources.

ElecShut.label: Electricity Shutoff
ElecShut.description: When the world's electricity turns off.

AlarmDecay.label: Alarm Battery Decay
AlarmDecay.description: How long alarm batteries last after power shuts off.

WaterShutModifier.label: Water Shutoff Modifier
WaterShutModifier.description: Fine-tune water shutoff timing in days.

ElecShutModifier.label: Electricity Shutoff Modifier
ElecShutModifier.description: Fine-tune electricity shutoff timing in days.

AlarmDecayModifier.label: Alarm Decay Modifier
AlarmDecayModifier.description: Fine-tune alarm battery decay timing in days.

ErosionSpeed.label: Erosion Speed
ErosionSpeed.description: How fast nature reclaims the world.

ErosionDays.label: Custom Erosion Days
ErosionDays.description: Custom erosion days. 0 = use Erosion Speed option.

EnableSnowOnGround.label: Snow on Ground
EnableSnowOnGround.description: Whether snow accumulates on the ground.

TimeSinceApo.label: Time Since Apocalypse
TimeSinceApo.description: How long after the apocalypse the game begins. Affects erosion and food spoilage.

StatsDecrease.label: Stats Decrease
StatsDecrease.description: How fast hunger, thirst, and fatigue decrease.

Nutrition.label: Nutrition
Nutrition.description: Food nutrition affects player weight and condition.

FridgeFactor.label: Fridge Effectiveness
FridgeFactor.description: How effective fridges are at preserving food.

StarterKit.label: Starter Kit
StarterKit.description: Spawn with chips, water bottle, backpack, bat, and hammer.

CharacterFreePoints.label: Free Character Points
CharacterFreePoints.description: Extra free points during character creation.

BoneFracture.label: Bone Fractures
BoneFracture.description: Survivors can get broken limbs from impacts, falls, etc.

InjurySeverity.label: Injury Severity
InjurySeverity.description: Impact of injuries and healing time.

HoursForCorpseRemoval.label: Corpse Removal Hours
HoursForCorpseRemoval.description: Hours before zombie corpses disappear. 0 = no maggots spawn.

DecayingCorpseHealthImpact.label: Corpse Health Impact
DecayingCorpseHealthImpact.description: Impact of nearby decaying bodies on health/emotions.

ZombieHealthImpact.label: Zombie Health Impact
ZombieHealthImpact.description: Whether living zombies also affect player health/emotions.

BloodLevel.label: Blood Level
BloodLevel.description: How much blood sprays on surfaces.

ClothingDegradation.label: Clothing Degradation
ClothingDegradation.description: How quickly clothing degrades and gets dirty.

DaysForRottenFoodRemoval.label: Rotten Food Removal Days
